Root Cause Description: Keypad invoked non-existent route POST /telephony/outbound-call returning HTTP 404 Not Found.
Telephony capacity configuration set inboundReserved=20 or 5 on a providerLimit=3 trunk causing availableForOutbound <= 0 and returning INSUFFICIENT_INBOUND_RESERVE for every call.
Remediation & File Path: Updated capacity config via PATCH /telephony/capacity/config to {totalChannels:3, inboundReserved:1, maxOutboundChannels:2}. Must persist in backend seed/migration on backend laptop.

Root Cause Description: Page handler only checked res.ok without validating data.success !== false or token presence causing dummy room initialization with undefined token on throttled responses.
Remediation & File Path: Added explicit validation if (data.success === false || !data.token) with user alert in superadminapp/src/features/crm/modules/pages/call-center/page.tsx (Commit 6b60af20)

Root Cause Description: Backend throws unhandled HTTP 500 Internal Server Error when receiving valid Vobiz incoming webhook payloads causing Vobiz to drop PSTN callers immediately.
Remediation & File Path: Add try/catch with fallback XML in /vobiz/incoming controller and verify LiveKit inbound SIP dispatch & agent queue resolution on backend laptop.

Root Cause Description: Outbound dial request omitted agentId causing backend call logs and agent state tracking to attribute calls to an unassigned agent.
Remediation & File Path: Extract agentId from localStorage crm_user and attach to POST /telephony/calls/outbound body in superadminapp/src/features/crm/modules/components/call-center/NumericKeypad.tsx (Commit 6b60af20)

Root Cause Description: Backend fails to create LiveKit inbound SIP participant or dispatch room during inbound webhook processing due to missing or invalid SIP inbound trunk credentials.
Remediation & File Path: Verify LIVEKIT_SIP_INBOUND_TRUNK_ID and LiveKit SIP dispatch service in backend .env on backend laptop.

Root Cause Description: Inbound webhook lacks fallback TwiML/Vobiz XML announcement resulting in immediate carrier disconnect when error occurs rather than playing hold music or failure announcement.
Remediation & File Path: Implement fallback XML response in NestJS exception filter to play audio message to caller.
